overview.description: The Global X U.S. 500 Income Edge ETF (EDGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund offers exposure to the broad US 500 equity market while employing an options-based overlay to pursue regular income. It pairs equity exposure with option premium generation to supplement yield. EDGX was launched on Feb 17, 2026 and is issued by Global X.
